title: Fix compute(a, b) in src/main.py to return the minimum of two finite numeric inputs
description: The function compute(a, b) in src/main.py currently returns None instead of the minimum of its two inputs. Required behavior: compute(a, b) must return the minimum of two finite numeric inputs, e.g. compute(2, 3) == 2. It must support zero, negative and fractional values. Fix: implement compute to return min(a, b) for finite numeric inputs. Reproduce the failure first, then edit src/main.py, run the public behavioral check with /opt/anaconda3/bin/python checks/public_check.py, and build with /opt/anaconda3/bin/python -m compileall -q src.
